1.Heard Sri Dheerendra Kumar Agnihotri, the learned counsel for the applicant, the learned A.G.A.
for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
246 of 2023, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Haidrabad,
District Lakhimpur Kheri.

sentences.text: The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 17.06.2023 against four persons, including the applicant, alleging that co-accused-Supyari tried to make fraudulent withdrawals from the bank account of another person and in her custodial statement, she stated that other persons, including the applicant, were also involved with her in commission of the offence.
Police claimed to have recorded a sum of Rs.130/- from applicant.

sentences.text: In the affidavit filed in support of bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.

The applicant's involvement in four other cases has been explained by filing a supplementary affidavit, in three of which the applicant has been granted bail and in fourth case he has been granted bail after filing of the supplementary affidavit.

It has also been submitted that the co-accused persons Prem Kanhaiya and Avadhesh Kumar have already been enlarged on bail by this court by means of an order dated 07.08.2023, passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9873 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9873 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 5. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicants have been implicated in the present case on the basis of custodial statement of co-accused-Shivpyari that no incriminating material has been recovered from the applicant and co-accused persons Prem Kanhaiya and Avadhesh Kumar have already been enlarged on bail and the applicant is languishing in jail since 18.06.2023 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
7.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
(Subhash Vidyarthi, J.) Order Date :- 18.9.2023

opennyai_summary.facts:
The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 17.06.2023 against four persons, including the applicant, alleging that co-accused-Supyari tried to make fraudulent withdrawals from the bank account of another person and in her custodial statement, she stated that other persons, including the applicant, were also involved with her in commission of the offence.
It has also been submitted that the co-accused persons Prem Kanhaiya and Avadhesh Kumar have already been enlarged on bail by this court by means of an order dated 07.08.2023, passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.9873 of 2023.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicants have been implicated in the present case on the basis of custodial statement of co-accused-Shivpyari that no incriminating material has been recovered from the applicant and co-accused persons Prem Kanhaiya and Avadhesh Kumar have already been enlarged on bail and the applicant is languishing in jail since 18.06.2023 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
8. Let the applicant-Gufran be released on bail in Case Crime No. 246 of 2023, under Sections 419,
420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Haidrabad, District Lakhimpur Kheri on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of magistrate/court concerned, subject to following conditions:-
(i) the applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence;
(ii) the applicant shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses;
(iii) the applicant shall appear on each and every date fixed by the trial court.
.
